note: The Curiosities Table (d66) and its items (Playtest v1.10, pp. 153–158). A curiosity's value is rolled when it is sold; it counts for nothing in the warband rating. Stash items are never carried.

wargear.name: Jar of Canal Leeches
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Stash Item, d6 silver*

This item can be used to leech blood in step 6 of the aftermath sequence.

wargear.name: Healing Tonic
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]:** Heal this fighter d6 life.

wargear.name: Tonic of Speed
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]:** For the rest of the battle, add 1 to this fighter's Move value.

wargear.name: Tonic of Strength
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]:** For the rest of the battle, improve this fighter's Blade value by 1.

wargear.name: Tonic of Steady Aim
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]:** For the rest of the battle, improve this fighter's Bow value by 1.

wargear.name: Tonic of Fortitude
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]:** For the rest of the battle, improve this fighter's Armour value by 1.

wargear.name: Tonic of Mind
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]:** For the rest of the battle, add 1 to this fighter's Initiative and Willpower values.

wargear.name: Tonic of Levitation
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Drink Tonic [Bonus Action]:** This fighter can fly.

At the start of each of this fighter's subsequent activations, roll a dice. On a 1-3, the effect ends. On a 4+ the effect continues.

wargear.name: Book of Funeral Rites
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Rare 0-1, 2d6 silver*

Each time another friendly fighter is killed. This fighter earns 5 bonus experience.

wargear.name: Gunsmith's Kit
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Unclog [Bonus Action]:** Pick a weapon the fighter is armed with that has suffered the 'Clogged' result on the misfire table. That weapon is no longer clogged and can be used to make attacks with once more.

wargear.name: Physician's Kit
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Stash Item, 2d6 silver*

You can use this item after making an injury roll for a friendly fighter. Re-roll the injury roll.

wargear.name: Blinding Powder
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 2d6 silver*

While this fighter is engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Throw Powder [Bonus Action]:** Pick an enemy fighter engaged in melee with this fighter and roll a dice. On a 2+, that fighter is blinded until the end of the activation. While a fighter is blinded, subtract 1 from their attack rolls.

wargear.name: Vial of Poison
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make the following bonus action:

**Apply Poison [Bonus Action]:** Pick 1 of this fighter's melee weapons, for the rest of the battle it has the *Poison* weapon trait.

wargear.name: Blackrose Balm
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Stash Item, 3d6 silver*

You can use this item in step 6 of the aftermath sequence. Pick a friendly fighter that has a temporary injury and roll a dice. On a 2+ they no longer have that temporary injury.

wargear.name: Writ of Sorcery
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 3d6 silver*

When a fighter is given this item, pick one of your faction's spell lores and randomly determine a spell from it. The fighter can use an Arcane Action to cast this spell even if they are not a *Wizard* or *Priest*. In addition, do not make a casting roll. Instead roll a dice; On a 1, the spell miscasts, on a 2-5 it casts, and on a 6 it critically casts.

wargear.name: Ivory Memento Mori
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, 3d6 silver*

The next time an injury roll for this fighter is 'killed', you can treat the injury roll as 'full recovery'. Then, this item is removed.

wargear.name: Alchemist's Fire
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 3d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make a ranged attack action with the following weapon: Range Flame, Attacks 1, Rend –, Damage d3, Critical Damage –, *Flame*, *Scare*.

wargear.name: Treasure Map
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Stash Item, 2d6x5 silver*

You can use this item when exploring the City. Instead of making an exploration roll, roll a dice: on a 1, **Forgery** – after circling for hours, you conclude this map leads nowhere, and you find nothing; on a 2+, **X Marks the Spot** – you receive 3d6x5 silver, and roll once on the Relics table.

wargear.name: Dwarven Bomb
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, 4d6 silver*

While this fighter is not engaged in melee, they can use this item to make a ranged attack action with the following weapon: Range 8", Attacks 1, Rend -1, Damage d3+1, Critical Damage –, *Blast*.

wargear.name: Etched Silver Bullets
wargear.text:
*Curiosity, Item, Consumable, d6 silver per bullet*

The item has 3+d3 silver bullets. Keep track of how many remain during the campaign. While a fighter is equipped with this item and is equipped with an eligible weapon (Blackpowder Pistol, Blackpowder Rifle, Brace of Pistols, Heirloom Duelling Pistol, Long Rifle, Repeater Pistol), they can use 1 silver bullet to make the bonus action below. The item is removed when no silver bullets remain.

**Load Silver Bullet [Bonus Action]:** For the next ranged attack this fighter makes this activation with an eligible weapon, improve the Rend value by 1, and it has the *Arcane* weapon trait.
